exports.notes: Production LOC source refresh. Criterion mapping remains disabled in the pipeline; approved LOC criterion claims are applied in a separate source-replacing backfill stage.

criterion_mapping.notes: Intentionally disabled here. After this source refresh succeeds, apply config/loc_fdd_sustainability_backfill.production.json so old LOC criterion claims are replaced at source scope rather than managed only by rules that happened to emit claims in this run.

sources.notes: Reviewed LOC FDD projection. The production source structure exposes only LOC's seven official sustainability factors at native_fields.sustainability_factors; Documentation is retained under native_fields.sustainability_factor_details.disclosure.documentation. PUID/QID strings found in XML prose remain contextual only.
